Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing deck & next steps

Hi Sam / Jorge,

Thanks again for taking the time to meet today — great conversation on where ACME is headed for Q4 and how you’re thinking about scaling LLM features while keeping unit costs predictable.

Quick recap from my side:
- Current priority: pilot conversational search on product pages (10–15k monthly active users)
- Key constraints: sub-300ms tail latency for search snippets, and tenant isolation for logging
- Success metric: reduce latency and cost per query vs current managed endpoint

Attached is the pricing estimate and a short deck that maps our recommended deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated) to your expected throughput. The deck includes an example rollout plan and cost sensitivity at different QPS levels.

Attachment: ACME-Redwood-Pricing-Estimate-2026-06-22.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)

Next steps I propose:
1) I can walk through the deck with the team — 30 minutes to cover questions and call out tradeoffs
2) If it looks good, we can lock in a short pilot commitment for a 6-week proof-of-value

Available slots this week: Tue 6/23 10:00–11:00 PT, Wed 6/24 14:00–15:00 PT. If those don't work, tell me a couple times that do or share a calendar link and I'll send an invite.

Looping in Ben Carter (cc) who will help with the Dedicated sizing if we move forward.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick read, Sam — good questions. Answers below: 

1) Committed throughput is per Dedicated cluster. For a multi-tenant pilot we typically either set a shared cluster with reservations per tenant (we can carve guarantees) or provision per-tenant nodes if isolation is a hard requirement. Ben (cc) can outline sizing options — he and I can recommend the cheapest configuration that meets your isolation SLA.

2) Integration: we have a short integration checklist for SSO (SAML/OIDC) and common logging sinks (CloudWatch, BigQuery, or a secure syslog endpoint). For the pilot we'll help with the initial wiring — typical effort is 1–2 developer days for SSO and 1–2 days to add structured logs to your pipeline (depends on how much parsing you want).

If that sounds good, I can book 30 minutes to walk through the deck and answer any follow-ups. I can do Wed 6/24 2pm PT (I’ll hold that slot for you) or Thu 6/25 11am PT. If you want to invite the engineering lead, that'd be great.

Best,
Marissa
